help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Quickly find answers to your questions.

findProduct.q: How do I find a product?
findProduct.a: Use the search bar at the top of the home page to search for a product, shop, or category. You can also browse categories and trending sections.

howToBuy.a: Click on a product to see its details, add it to your cart if available, then contact the seller directly on WhatsApp to finalize the order.

howToPay.a: StatusMarket connects buyers and sellers. Payment happens directly between you and the seller, based on terms you agree on (mobile money, cash, transfer, etc.).

createShop.q: How do I create my shop?
createShop.aAfter: , create a seller account, then fill out the shop creation form. You'll then be able to add your products and manage your orders.

report.a: If you come across inappropriate content or a scam, use the report button on the relevant shop or product page.

dataCollected.title: 1. Data collected
dataCollected.body: StatusMarket collects the information needed to run the platform: name, email address, WhatsApp number, shop and product information. We do not collect banking information.

dataUse.title: 2. Use of data
dataUse.body: Data is used to display shops and products, enable contact between buyers and sellers, and improve the user experience. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.

security.title: 3. Security
security.body: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration.

rights.title: 4. Your rights
rights.body: You can request that your data be changed or deleted by contacting us at

contact.title: 5. Contact
contact.body: For any question about this policy, contact us at
